card.title: 5th LEGIONS REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 5th Legions Infantry Regiment was an infantry regiment of the Polish Army from 1918-1939. In 1939, during the defense of Poland the regiment was part of the 1st Legions Infantry Division. The division was part of Operational Group Wyszków and was tasked with defending the north of Warsaw against German attacks from East Prussia. The regiment would see some heavy fighting during the Battle of Kałuszy and the Battle of Seroczyn against Panzer Division Kempf, where they suffered heavy casualties. The remaining survivors of the 5th Regiment surrendered to the German forces on 23 September near the city of Zamość.
